description: Add, remove, enable, disable, or move a firewall mangle rule, IPv4 (family ip, the default) or IPv6 (family ipv6). ruleAction sets the action; when it is omitted, a new* value implies its own (newRoutingMark → mark-routing), otherwise accept. Each new* value is accepted only under its action. Uses comment as idempotency key: a repeated add returns already_exists only when the chain, match fields, marks, DSCP, MSS, passthrough, and the given or implied action agree, otherwise CONFLICT. move takes ruleId and destination (a rule .id to place it before, or end) instead of comment, and returns no_change when the rule is already there; dynamic rules cannot be moved. Supports dry-run mode.

action.description: Action to perform: add, remove, enable, or disable a rule (found by comment), or move a rule (by ruleId) before another

chain.description: Mangle chain (required on add): prerouting, input, forward, output, postrouting

comment.description: Idempotency key — uniquely identifies this mangle rule; required except for move

confirmationToken.description: Token from a prior APPROVAL_REQUIRED response. Re-submit the identical call with this token to confirm the destructive action.

destination.description: Where to move the rule: the .id of the rule to place it before, or end for the bottom of the table; move only

dstAddressList.description: Destination address list name to match

family.description: Address family: ip (IPv4, /ip firewall) or ipv6 (/ipv6 firewall)

newMss.description: MSS to set: a number or clamp-to-pmtu (ruleAction change-mss, with protocol tcp and tcpFlags syn)

newRoutingMark.description: Routing mark to set (ruleAction mark-routing, chain prerouting or output)

passthrough.description: Whether to continue matching subsequent rules

routerId.description: Router ID; omit to use the default router.

ruleAction.description: Mangle action, add only. Omitted: the action of the new* value given (newRoutingMark → mark-routing, newConnectionMark → mark-connection, newPacketMark → mark-packet, newDscpValue → change-dscp, newMss → change-mss), else accept, the RouterOS default

ruleId.description: Rule to move, by its RouterOS .id (e.g. *1A, from the list tool); move only

srcAddressList.description: Source address list name to match

tcpFlags.description: TCP flags to match, comma-separated, ! negates one (e.g. "syn"); needs protocol tcp

name: manage_mangle_rule
title: Manage Mangle Rule
